entities.summary: Redang Island is an island in Kuala Nerus District, Terengganu, Malaysia. It is one of the largest islands off the east coast of Peninsular Malaysia. It is one of nine islands that made up an eponymous marine sanctuary park offering snorkeling and diving opportunities for tourists.
